title: Help and support to lodge your tax return

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

If you need help lodging your tax return our Tax Help program is free and helps individuals with simple tax affairs.

Our Tax Help program is free and helps eligible people earning $70,000 or less lodge their tax return online.

Become a Tax Help volunteer and help people in your community prepare and lodge their tax returns online using myTax.

We're looking for community centres that want to support our face-to-face Tax Help service.

The National Tax Clinic program can help eligible individuals and small businesses with their tax affairs.

Use a registered tax agent to prepare and lodge your tax return, they are the only people that can charge a fee.
